sourceTitle: NIST — How do I create a good password?
exactSourceStatements: NIST guidance recommends that a password should be at least 15 characters long.
NIST no longer recommends that passwords require special characters and numbers.
A passphrase combines multiple real words together to create something that's easier to invent and remember.
avoiding reused passwords across multiple websites, as a compromised password from one site could compromise all accounts
securityScope: Sorular temel farkındalık düzeyinde: uzunluk, tekrar kullanım riski, passphrase. Operasyonel saldırı talimatı YOK — 'brute force saniyede 100 milyar deneme' olgusu da soruya çevrilmedi.
